assignment_name: Essay 6: Market Segmentation and Go to Market Strategies

criteria.name: Makes full use of case studies, lectures, and readings
criteria.full_marks_description: Substantively engages with multiple specific cases, lectures, or readings. Ideas are explicitly connected back to the source material with concrete references (author names, case names, key concepts).
criteria.partial_marks_description: References source material but only superficially, or engages with only one source, or paraphrases without clear attribution.

criteria.name: Weaves in personal experiences from own career and/or anecdotes from others
criteria.full_marks_description: Includes a clear, specific personal example or anecdote (a particular project, role, company, or situation) that is well-integrated into the argument and illustrates the point being made.
criteria.partial_marks_description: Mentions personal experience briefly, or the anecdote is generic or vague, or it is present but not well-integrated with the analysis.

criteria.name: Contains critical insight that goes beyond surface reflection
criteria.full_marks_description: Demonstrates original thinking. Identifies non-obvious connections, challenges or extends ideas in the readings, or applies frameworks in a novel way to the writer's own context.
criteria.partial_marks_description: Shows engagement with the ideas but mostly summarises rather than analyses, or the insight is conventional and predictable.

criteria.name: Fully addresses topics in the writing prompt
criteria.full_marks_description: Addresses every part of the writing prompt with substantive responses. No required topic is omitted or treated only in passing.
criteria.partial_marks_description: Addresses some parts of the prompt but not others, or addresses all parts only briefly without sufficient depth.
